To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a novel 3D wood log reconstruction approach that can be used for volume computation of wood piles.

we present the first mobile photogrammetric wood surveying method that is capable to reconstruct the entire 3D woodpile from multiple images and that we achieve state of the art results in terms of wood log detection, wood volume computation as well as wood pile volume computation.
the presented method is capable of performing photogrammetric survey of wood piles with a high accuracy and that the results are comparable to the results of a conventional survey.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a fully automatic, photogrammetric method for wood pile surveying.
the development of a novel photogrammetric method for wood pile surveying on mobile devices.
the development of a new method for photogrammetry-based surveying of wood piles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is a valuable alternative to conventional measurement techniques.
the proposed method is a promising approach for the photogrammetric survey of wood piles, especially when compared to existing methods.
the method presented here is a very good and robust alternative for the surveying of wood piles.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are the first to show that photogrammetry can be successfully used to perform wood pile surveys on mobile devices.
we have developed a fully automated method for the surveying of wood piles, which is based on a mobile device.
the presented method is capable of performing wood pile surveying in an automated manner and can be used to replace the manual process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
3D reconstruction of wood piles with mobile devices and photogrammetric survey of wood logs is possible and can be used to replace manual measurement techniques in forestry.
3D reconstruction and photogrammetric wood surveying can be performed on mobile devices.
mobile 3D wood log surveying is a feasible task that can be performed on a smartphone or digital device in the field.
